issue.body:
## Problem

`parseDuration("-5m")` returns `-300000`, and a negative timeout disables the watchdog.

## Fix

`parseDuration` rejects a negative value with the error `duration must be positive`.

## Done when

- [ ] Negative durations throw `duration must be positive`.
- [ ] Required: a test that fails if a negative duration does not throw.

pr.title: fix(sample-kit): reject negative durations
pr.body: Adds the negative-duration check and a test for it.
